topics.name: Giving a tentative opinion
topics.summary: Fikringizga to'liq ishonmasangiz yoki qisman qo'shilsangiz, gapni yumshatish uchun.

usage.text: I'm not sure really. — «Rostini aytsam, aniq bilmayman». Qat'iy javob bermaslik.

example.en: A: Should shoplifters go to prison? B: I'm not sure really.
example.uz: A: Do'kon o'g'rilari qamalishi kerakmi? B: Aniq bilmayman.

usage.text: I agree to some extent. — «Ma'lum darajada qo'shilaman». Qisman rozilik, ko'pincha keyin «but».

example.en: I agree to some extent, but it depends on the crime.
example.uz: Ma'lum darajada qo'shilaman, lekin jinoyatga bog'liq.

usage.text: I suppose it's true to say that ... — «Menimcha, ... deyish to'g'ri bo'lsa kerak».

example.en: I suppose it's true to say that crime is falling.
example.uz: Jinoyat kamayyapti deyish to'g'ri bo'lsa kerak.

structure.formula: I agree to some extent, but ...

example.en: I agree to some extent, but not completely.

structure.formula: I suppose it's true to say that + gap

example.en: I suppose it's true to say that people are kinder now.

topics.tip: «I agree in some extent» — xato. To'g'ri predlog: «to some extent».

topics.name: Making an additional point
topics.summary: Bitta fikrdan keyin yana bir dalil qo'shish uchun. Ko'proq yozma va rasmiy nutqda.

usage.text: Moreover, ... — «Bundan tashqari, ...». Yangi gap boshida, keyin vergul.

example.en: Prison is expensive. Moreover, it doesn't always work.
example.uz: Qamoq qimmat. Bundan tashqari, har doim ham foyda bermaydi.

example.en: The town is safe. Furthermore, it's very clean.

usage.text: What is more, ... — «Buning ustiga, ...». Uch so'zli ibora.

example.en: He stole a car. What is more, he crashed it.
example.uz: U mashina o'g'irladi. Buning ustiga, uni urib qo'ydi.

structure.formula: Gap 1. Moreover, / Furthermore, / What is more, + gap 2

example.en: It's cheap. What is more, it's fast.

topics.tip: Bu so'zlar QO'SHIMCHA fikr uchun. Qarama-qarshi fikr uchun «However» ishlatiladi — adashtirmang.

mistakes.wrong: I suppose it's true say that ...
mistakes.right: I suppose it's true to say that ...

mistakes.wrong: It's cheap. Moreover, it's very expensive to repair.
mistakes.right: It's cheap. However, it's very expensive to repair.
mistakes.why: Qarama-qarshi fikr uchun «However», «Moreover» — qo'shimcha fikr uchun.
